nodes.label: Basket Data
nodes.rationale: Used to list constituent reference entities of a basket in multi-name credit derivatives (e.g. index CDS); each Name sub-node can specify a CreditCurveId directly or reference a ReferenceInformation node instead, so pricing can key off either component-level curves or a single index curve.

nodes.label: Bond Basket Data
nodes.rationale: Wraps a list of full Bond trades (id, TradeType, Envelope, BondData) inside a CBOTranches-bearing Cashflow CDO trade, functioning like a portfolio of bonds but keyed under BondBasketData instead of Portfolio so the collateral pool can be priced and allocated to tranches.

nodes.label: CBO Tranches
nodes.rationale: Each Tranche carries ICRatio (BasketInterest / TrancheInterest incl. senior tranches) and OCRatio (BasketNotional / TrancheNotional incl. senior tranches) so that waterfall seniority and overcollateralisation/interest-coverage triggers in a Cashflow CDO can be modeled per tranche, with either a FixedLegData or FloatingLegData return profile.

nodes.label: CDS Reference Information
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates the contractually agreed ReferenceEntityId, Tier, Currency and DocClause that together determine which credit curve is used to price a credit derivative, providing an alternative to specifying a CreditCurveId directly.

nodes.label: CMB Leg
nodes.rationale: Built in close analogy to the CMS leg but linked to a Constant Maturity Bond yield index; projects future fixings via a forward-starting bond priced off reference yield/credit curves rather than a swaption-implied convexity adjustment, and consequently does not (yet) support Caps/Floors or convexity adjustment, unlike the CMS leg.

nodes.label: CMS Spread Leg
nodes.rationale: Reuses the CMSLegData schema but replaces the single CMS index with the difference of two CMS indices (Index1 minus Index2), so that setting NakedOption true turns a capped/floored leg into an explicit CMS Spread Option payoff.

nodes.label: Commodity Fixed Leg
nodes.rationale: Quantities can be omitted and instead inherited from a paired Commodity Floating Leg on the same trade (optionally disambiguated via a shared Tag) so that fixed and floating legs of a commodity swap need not duplicate quantity schedules.

nodes.label: Digital CMS Leg
nodes.rationale: Wraps an underlying CMSLegData block with call/put digital strike and payoff nodes; the NakedOption flag on the embedded CMS leg lets the digital option payoff be isolated from the underlying CMS coupon.

nodes.label: Digital CMS Spread Leg
nodes.rationale: Wraps an underlying CMSSpreadLegData block with call/put digital strike and payoff nodes; the NakedOption flag on the embedded CMS Spread leg separates the digital payoff from the underlying CMS Spread coupon.

nodes.label: Duration Adjusted CMS Leg
nodes.rationale: Extends CMSLegData with a Duration field n that scales the CMS fixing by an annuity-like factor sum(1/(1+gamma)^i, i=1..n); when Duration is zero or omitted the adjustment factor is 1 and the coupon reduces to an ordinary CMS coupon.

nodes.label: Equity Leg
nodes.rationale: NotionalReset toggles whether the leg fixes the share Quantity for all coupons (recomputing Notional each period from the share price and FX rate) or instead keeps Notional fixed and lets Quantity float, so the same leg schema covers both fixed-quantity and fixed-notional equity return structures.

nodes.label: Equity Margin Leg
nodes.rationale: Used to represent the financing/margin side of a Total Return Swap on an Equity Index Future: the TRS is booked as TradeType Swap with one leg of type Equity (index performance) and the other of type EquityMargin (margin factor financing), with both legs referencing the Equity Index name rather than the Future.

hyperedges.label: CMS-Linked Leg Family (CMS, CMS Spread, Digital CMS, Digital CMS Spread, Duration Adjusted CMS)
